#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    long long mod = 998244353;
    int n;
    int m;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = mult(p, n - i, smallInv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long numPhases = mult(m + k, smallInv(k));
            long long term = mult(mult(ncr(n, k), numPhases), phaseSize);
            if ((k & 1) == 1)
                answer = add(answer, term);
            else
                answer = subtract(answer, term);
        }

        out << answer << endl;
    }

private:
    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        assert(n >= 0);
        if (r < 0 || n < r)
            return 0;
        return mult(fact(n), mult(smallInv(r), smallInv(n - r)));
    }

    long long smallInv(int n) {
        return mult(smallInv(n), fact(n - 1));
    }

    long long fact(int n) {
        while (factorial.size() <= n) {
            factorial.push((int) mult(factorial.back(), factorial.size()));
        }

        return factorial.back();
    }

    long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }

    long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < mod ? v : v - mod;
    }

    long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + mod : v;
    }

    long long inv(long long value) {
        long long g = mod, x = 0, y = 1;
        for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;

            long long temp = g;
            g = r;
            r = temp;

            x -= q * y;

            temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
        }

        assert(g == 1);
        assert(y == mod || y == -mod);

        return x;
    }

    vector<long long> factorial;
};

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader(istream& stream) : stream_(stream) {}

    int nextInt() {
        string line;
        getline(stream_, line);
        stringstream ss(line);
        int num;
        ss >> num;
        return num;
    }

private:
    istream& stream_;
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    ostream& out = cout;
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}

class Util {
public:
    static void ASSERT(bool assertion) {
        if (!assertion)
            throw runtime_error("Assertion failed");
    }
};

class IntStack {
public:
    vector<int> array;

    void push(int item) {
        if (array.size() >= array.capacity())
            array.resize(array.capacity() * 2);
        array.push_back(item);
    }

    int size() const {
        return array.size();
    }

    int get(int i) const {
        Util::ASSERT(i < array.size());
        return array[i];
    }

    void resize(int capacity) {
        array.resize(capacity);
    }

    string toString() const {
        vector<int> trimmed(array.begin(), array.end());
        return to_string(trimmed);
    }
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    public:
        vector<long long> factorial;
        vector<long long> invFactorial;

        Modulus() : factorial(1, 1), invFactorial(1, 1) {}

        long long modulus() const {
            return mod;
        }

        long long fact(int n) const {
            while (factorial.size() <= n) {
                factorial.push_back((long long) factorial.back() * factorial.size());
            }

            return factorial[n];
        }

        long long fInv(int n) const {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.size() - 1;

            if (lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown + 1);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < fInv.size(); i++) {
                    fInv[i] = (long long) fInv[i - 1] * (n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push_back(fInv[i]);
                }
            }

            return invFactorial[n];
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) const {
            assert(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r)
                return 0;
            return (long long) fact(n) * (long long) mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r));
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) const {
            return (long long) fInv(n) * fact(n - 1);
        }

        long long normalize(long x) const {
            x %= mod;
            if (x < 0)
                x += mod;
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a + b;
            return v < mod ? v : v - mod;
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a - b;
            return v < 0 ? v + mod : v;
        }

        long long mult(long long... x) const {
            long long r = 1;
            for (long long i : x)
                r = mult(r, i);
            return r;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            return (a * b) % mod;
        }

        long long inv(long long value) const {
            long long g = mod, x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;

                long long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                x -= q * y;

                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            assert(g == 1);
            assert(y == mod || y == -mod);

            return x;
        }

    private:
        long long mod;
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        Mod998() : Modulus(), mod(998244353) {}
    };
};
